Elena / Aisha — jumping in with technical clarifications so we craft precisely what you need. Short answers below and items we will attach: 

SAST / DAST:
- SAST: we run tiered static analysis across our monorepo pipeline with Semgrep and an internal ruleset; scans run on every PR and weekly full-repo scans.
- DAST: we use an external provider for authenticated DAST over our public control plane; full scans run quarterly and targeted scans pre-release.
- Coverage targets: SAST aims to flag new critical/high issues at PR time; historical vulnerability backlog is tracked to zero tolerance for criticals.

Pen Test:
- Most recent third-party penetration test: Engarde Security (2026-06). We will provide an executive summary (redacted) and remediation status table showing fixes and mitigations. Full report is vendor-limited and cannot be shared in full; we will attach the redacted summary.

SBOM:
- We can export component-level SBOM in CSV; CycloneDX on request (we'll include a CSV by 11/09). Please confirm if CycloneDX is required for ingestion into your systems.

Patch SLAs & Remediation:
- Critical (CVSS >= 9): acknowledged within 2 business hours, remediation or mitigation within 72 hours (aim 48 where possible).
- High (7-8.9): acknowledged within 1 business day, remediation within 14 days.
- Medium/Low: acknowledged within 3 business days, remediation within 30/90 days respectively.
- Escalation path: alert triage -> engineering on-call -> Product Security -> Customer success / procurement notice (per contract).

Attachments we will provide: [attachment: redwood_pen_test-summary.pdf] (executive summary), [attachment: patch_sla-matrix.xlsx], [attachment: redwood_sbom-component-level.csv].

If BluePeak needs signed attestation language, flag which template you prefer and we'll route for signature.

—Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
